pr_title: HA deconz: Add support for Tuya Smart Air Housekeeper 6in1 Air Quality Monitor
pr_body: ## Breaking change **NO BREAKING CHANGES** ## MERGE ORDER Needs to be merged once [pydeconz PR #408](https://github.com/Kane610/deconz/pull/408) ✅ is merged ## Proposed change bump dependency pydeconz to [v111](https://github.com/Kane610/deconz/releases/tag/v111)(click for changelog) ### Goal: Add support for [Tuya Smart Air Housekeeper](https://zigbee.blakadder.com/Tuya_DCR-KQG.html) (aka TS0601 | _TZE200_dwcarsat) ### Introduction: This PR is a part of series of PR's affecting the repos: deconz-rest-plugin, pydeconz, homeassistant. ### Reference: - https://github.com/dresden-elektronik/deconz-rest-plugin/pull/6739 - https://github.com/dresden-elektronik/deconz-rest-plugin/pull/6673 - https://github.com/Kane610/deconz/pull/408 ### Technical Details: - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/98e3dccc892a76734f1a7d1a9bd22ce03ff00b4b works together with https://github.com/Kane610/deconz/commit/f9bca6db80fb5e19871bbea1f210cfd70a556188 and enable a check if the sensor entity should be created / if there is a value supplied by deconz-rest-api via pydeconz - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/13fd7c29b0442c25bfa370d3dccc3af884fe0c33 imports / prepare for the new sensor entities - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/21505ad575a4787e20819017aee8b77bc35063c5 adding the formaldehyde sensor entity - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/1580c952cd78f5f0d98312219da9b0d83061d5a1 adding the co2 sensor entity - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/7b5e7e72e3046c407c4a878c73c83ad8a5f9737d adding the pm25 sensor entity **HINT** as of Arch Discussion: [#858](https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/discussions/858) best practise for voc sensors which use ppb is to have no device_class (airqualityppb) ### POC: **Proof Of Concept is already up and running**, result in HA once all PR's are merged: ## Type of change - [x] Dependency upgrade - [ ] Bugfix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) - [ ] New integration (thank you!) - [x] New feature (which adds functionality to an existing integration) - [ ] Deprecation (breaking change to happen in the future) - [ ] Breaking change (fix/feature causing existing functionality to break) - [ ] Code quality improvements to existing code or addition of tests ## Additional information - This PR fixes or closes issue: fixes #89708 (pydeconz v111) - This PR is related to issue: https://github.com/dresden-elektronik/deconz-rest-plugin/issues/5889 - Link to documentation pull request: ## Checklist - [x] The code change is tested and works locally. - ### The problem

Since the go-live of https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/89397 in 2023.3.4 , all of the warnings are gone except for one: "unexpected light effect loop"

Looking at the deconz REST API get statement (https://pastebin.com/pJx122Ad) and comparing it with https://github.com/Kane610/deconz/commit/41ad811cc5643b8408aa780f00261d2663acdc6c ,  the value "loop" (no capitals) seems to be  missing.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74881023/225075004-e3a9ffd7-6838-4f9d-b630-b7d70656857e.png)

core-2023.3.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

deCONZ

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/deconz/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt

Last logged: 08:10:53

Unexpected light effect type loop
```


### Additional information

_No response_
